mapping: iNES PRG starts at file offset 0x0010; fixed CPU window $C000-$DFFF maps bank $1E. $DAF5 maps to file offset 0x03DB05.
scope: One ROM-derived caller span, fixed-bank $DAF5-$DB0E, ending after the JSR $E6EC call transfers control and before the callee executes.

spans.source_role: After the fresh-match $DC07 position initializer returns, derive a receiver index from $00E2 & $07, fold indices 5..7 by subtracting 5, read its offset from $DC82, add $05FB, store the selected slot at $05FC, and call $E6EC.
